projects.title: Venue Synthesis
projects.description: Advanced audio synthesis platform for professional venue systems. Led frontend architecture and UI/UX implementation for real-time audio control and visualization.
highlights: Built the UI for a Sound Pressure Level (SPL) visualization platform used to map and optimize acoustics for a 125k-capacity venue
Implemented virtualized rendering for 10k+ record accordion views, minimizing DOM footprint and ensuring consistent UI responsiveness as dataset size scaled
Drove adoption of a JSON-driven, API-backed dynamic UI rendering framework, standardizing frontend architecture and reducing per-feature development effort by 60%
Partnered with QA and business stakeholders to define acceptance criteria for 4 different modules, achieving zero critical production defects across 3 consecutive releases

projects.title: AI Mode Toggle
projects.description: Smooth, modern AI mode toggle animation inspired by Google's design. Pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript implementation with responsive design.

projects.title: EmergencyTime
projects.description: A responsive web application designed to help people be better prepared to deal with natural disasters. Shipped boot time improvements and increased accessibility with slow internet connectivity.
highlights: Launched to help people prepare for natural disasters
Improved accessibility with slow internet connectivity
